verdict.rationale: Oyster's own developer docs offer dedicated developer sandboxes, pre-loaded with seed data, for integration development. That lets API users build and test against a non-production environment. The evidence is a single short doc statement, though, with little detail on provisioning, isolation guarantees or parity with production endpoints. Missing for 10: details on sandbox provisioning and credentials, explicit confirmation of isolation from production data, production/sandbox API parity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
